title: Base images must be pulled from the internal Artifactory mirror and pinned by digest

source.excerpt: Heads up - effective Jan 15, the docker.io passthrough on our Artifactory proxy is shut off (SLSA L2 supply-chain requirement). All Dockerfiles and CI jobs must pull base images from artifactory.corp/docker-remote/. Anything still pointing at docker.io or public ECR will fail at build time. Also, unpinned tags like FROM ubuntu:latest are no longer permitted - pin by digest.

rules.description: FROM must resolve through artifactory.corp/docker-remote/, not a public registry.
Base images must be pinned by digest, not by a mutable tag.

autofix.instructions: Resolve the tag to a digest with `docker buildx imagetools inspect <image>` and replace the tag with @sha256:<digest>.

notes: Compiled from a single announcement carrying two distinct obligations.
